 Casa Grande Chamber of Commerce Marketing and Tourism Manager Eric Snider and Executive Director Renée Louzon-Benn unveil the logo for the newly renamed Fiesta de Casa Grande, which replaces the Southwest Taco Fest name attributed to the spring event. The annual festival will move to the Casa Grande rodeo grounds on Feb. 20, 2027, and feature professional bull riding, live music, food trucks and family entertainment.
